description: Zelenilo grada Zagreba is the public map of the green spaces of Croatia's capital, published by Zrinjevac. The viewer read on 2026-09-28 shows, over an OpenStreetMap basemap, layers of lawns, paths, surfaces, playgrounds, shrubs, flower beds, hedges, individual trees and urban furniture, with spatial query and geolocation tools. Coverage is public green areas of the City of Zagreb; the extent and number of mapped trees were not read. Access to the viewer is free, but no download, service address or licence was found in the page or its scripts, so reuse beyond viewing is unconfirmed. Caveats: attribute fields, such as tree species, size or condition, were not seen, and the viewer is in Croatian. It supports urban heat and storm studies of green infrastructure, such as locating street trees at risk of windthrow near roads and power lines, or mapping shade and permeable surfaces for heat adaptation plans. No related Zagreb green infrastructure record is catalogued.
